messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "if child has been prescribed the liquid form"
set: ["if child has been prescribed the liquid form", "discard the pen if it has been frozen", "call your doctor if the child has behavior changes", "call your doctor if the child has trouble concentrating", "call your doctor if the child has memory problems", "liquid form is an oral suspension", "use only the brand and form prescribed by your doctor", "process continues until the desired diuretic effect has been obtained", "mix with water if child prescribed tablets for oral suspension", "reduce dosage after adequate response has been reached", "dosing schedule occurs after dose has been settled", "call your doctor if the child is restless", "call your doctor if the child is hostile", "call your doctor if the child is aggressive", "skip the missed dose if it has been more than 4 days since your last dose", "if you switch from immediate-release metoprolol to the extended-release form"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
